_note: Purposes and responsibilities describe what each committee does in general. Members and contacts stay empty until the official list is supplied.

committees.name: Anti-Ragging Committee
committees.purpose: Prevents ragging and acts on complaints.
responsibilities: Monitor campus, hostels and transport for ragging

committees.name: Grievance Redressal Committee
committees.purpose: Hears and resolves grievances of students and staff.

committees.name: Internal Complaints Committee
committees.purpose: Addresses complaints of sexual harassment under the POSH Act.
responsibilities: Conduct inquiries as per the Act

committees.name: SC/ST Cell
committees.purpose: Safeguards the interests of SC/ST students and staff.

committees.name: Women Empowerment Cell
committees.purpose: Promotes the safety, wellbeing and leadership of women on campus.

committees.name: Discipline Committee
responsibilities: Frame and enforce the code of conduct
